business_problem: Pilot Company needed a better way to support fuel bill-of-lading document processing and billing automation because hundreds of handwritten form formats defeated OCR and RPA approaches, leaving a critical fuel billing workflow slow, error-prone, and expensive.
solution_summary: Pilot Company uses Databricks Data + AI Platform to support fuel bill-of-lading document processing and billing automation. The implementation replaced a legacy state where hundreds of handwritten form formats defeated OCR and RPA approaches, leaving a critical fuel billing workflow slow, error-prone, and expensive. Handwritten bills of lading and fuel delivery photos move through production data pipelines and land in Delta Lake, giving teams one trusted data foundation. Unity Catalog governs access, lineage, and compliance across sensitive datasets. MLflow, Agent Bricks, and Amazon Bedrock operationalize models, agents, and analytics that deliver structured billing records and automated billing decisions. Pilot Company improved fuel bill-of-lading document processing and billing automation with measurable results including 99% fueling efficiency from pump to profit, 90% decrease in overall processing costs, and Intelligent document processing at 98.
business_outcome: Pilot Company improved fuel bill-of-lading document processing and billing automation with measurable results including 99% fueling efficiency from pump to profit, 90% decrease in overall processing costs, and Intelligent document processing at 98.6% accuracy with Databricks Agent Bricks, while giving teams a faster path from governed data to production decisions.

evidence_quotes: We’ve tried traditional robotic process automation (RPA), but the forms varied so much it wasn’t feasible,
One of our biggest roadblocks was evaluating models,
We moved to a multi-modal model and had controlled access through Databricks. Feeding the model the actual photos of the BOL rather than extracted text boosted our accuracy all the way up to 94.3%,
We think it’s because of the model’s ability to preserve spatial reasoning — the layout of the checkboxes and form sections. These things previously were lost.
